treat.colors <- c("control"  = "darkseagreen" , "chicken"= "royalblue1", "cow" = "red3","pellet"= "darkorchid1","compost"="chocolate4")
treat.colors1 <- c("control_amf"  = "darkseagreen" , "chicken"= "royalblue1", "cow" = "red3","pellet"= "darkorchid1","compost"="chocolate4")

## Load data

```{r}
zotu97 <- import_qiime("01_Raw_data/p1031_run231218_Revio_16S_ZOTU_c97_Count_Sintax.txt")

metadata <- read.csv("01_Raw_data/metadata_2025.csv" ) %>% 
  column_to_rownames(var= "sample_name")
metadata$treat.pot <- paste(metadata$treatment, metadata$rep, sep= "_")

zotu97 <- merge_phyloseq(zotu97, sample_data(metadata))



##modifiyin the table to change rowxcol
otu_mat <- otu_table(`zotu97`)
if (taxa_are_rows(`zotu97`)) {
  otu_mat <- t(otu_mat)          
}
otu_mat <- as.matrix(otu_mat)
min_reads <- 3       
min_samples <- 3     
prevalence <- colSums(otu_mat >= min_reads)
keep_otus <- prevalence >= min_samples

otu_filt <- otu_mat[, keep_otus, drop = FALSE]
cat("ZOTUs kept:", ncol(otu_filt), "out of", ncol(otu_mat), "\n")


zotu_filt <- phyloseq(
  otu_table(otu_filt, taxa_are_rows = FALSE),
  sample_data(sample_data(zotu97)),      
  tax_table(tax_table(zotu97)[keep_otus, ])
)
zotu_filt
```

## TSS transformation

```{r}
zotu_tss_pct <- transform_sample_counts(
  zotu_filt,
  function(x) x / sum(x) * 100
)
```

## Actinobacteria

```{r actinobacteria}
cfu_actinobacteria<-readxl::read_excel("01_Raw_data/cfu_actinobacteria.xlsx")
phy_phylum <- tax_glom(zotu_tss_pct, taxrank = "Phylum")

actino_phy <- subset_taxa(
  phy_phylum,
  Phylum %in% c("Actinobacteriota", "Actinobacteria", "Actinomycetota")
)

actino_df <- psmelt(actino_phy) %>%
  dplyr::select(Sample, sample_ID, Abundance) %>%
  rename(RA_actino = Abundance)
actino_df <- as.data.frame(actino_df)
actino_df <- psmelt(actino_phy) %>%
  group_by(Sample, sample_ID) %>%
  summarise(RA_actino = sum(Abundance), .groups = "drop")

cfu_actino_join <- cfu_actinobacteria %>%
  left_join(actino_df, by = "sample_ID")

#CORRELATION
cfu_actino_join <- cfu_actino_join %>%
  mutate(
    log10_cfu = log10(cfu_g_soil), 
    RA_actino_t = log10(RA_actino+1)
  )
shapiro.test(cfu_actino_join$log10_cfu)
shapiro.test(cfu_actino_join$RA_actino_t)

 
cor_test <- cor.test(
  cfu_actino_join$log10_cfu,
  cfu_actino_join$RA_actino_t,
  method = "spearman"
)

cor_test
rho_val <- cor_test$estimate
p_val  <- cor_test$p.value
rho_val
p_val

label_text <- paste0(
  "Spearman ρ = ", round(rho_val, 3),
  "\n",
  "p = ", format(p_val, scientific = FALSE, digits = 3)
)

##graff
actinobacteria_plot <- ggplot(cfu_actino_join,
                              aes(x = log10_cfu, y = RA_actino)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = treatment), size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "black") +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = treat.colors,
    breaks = treat.order,
    labels = treat.labels,
    name   = "Treatment"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = expression(log[10]~"CFU g"^{-1}~"soil (cutivable Actinobacteria)"),
    y = "Relative abundance (%) (TSS)\n of putative cultivable Actinobacteria"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  annotate("text",
           x = Inf, y = Inf,
           hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.3,
           label = label_text,
           size = 5,
           fontface = "plain")

actinobacteria_plot


ggsave(actinobacteria_plot, file= "04_Figures/Supplemetary_FigureS7_Actinobacteria.png", width= 1900,height= 1200, units= "px")


saveRDS(actinobacteria_plot, file = '03_Analysis_files/Supplementary_plot/Supplemetary_FigureS7_Actinobacteria.rds')
```

## Bacteria

```{r}
bacteria<-readxl::read_excel("01_Raw_data/cfu_bacteria.xlsx")

unique(tax_table(zotu_tss_pct)[, "Phylum"])

bacteria_phy <- subset_taxa(
  zotu_tss_pct,
  Phylum %in% c("Firmicutes",
                "Proteobacteria",
                "Bacteroidota"))
bacteria_phy
unique(tax_table(bacteria_phy)[, "Phylum"])
table(tax_table(bacteria_phy)[, "Phylum"])

bacteria_df <- psmelt(bacteria_phy) %>%
  dplyr::select(Sample, sample_ID, Abundance) %>%
  rename(RA_bacteria = Abundance)
bacteria_df <- as.data.frame(bacteria_df)
rownames(bacteria_df) <- NULL


bacteria_df <- psmelt(bacteria_phy) %>%
  group_by(Sample, sample_ID) %>%
  summarise(RA_bacteria = sum(Abundance), .groups = "drop")

cfu_bacteria_join <- bacteria %>%
  left_join(bacteria_df, by = "sample_ID")

#CORRELATION
cfu_bacteria_join <- cfu_bacteria_join %>%
  mutate(
    log10_bacteria_cfu = log10(bacteria_cfu_g_soil), 
    RA_bacteria_t = log10(RA_bacteria),
  )
shapiro.test(cfu_bacteria_join$log10_bacteria_cfu)
shapiro.test(cfu_bacteria_join$RA_bacteria_t)


pearson_bact <- cor.test(
  cfu_bacteria_join$log10_bacteria_cfu,
  cfu_bacteria_join$RA_bacteria_t,
  method = "pearson"
)
pearson_bact
#model
lm_bact <- lm(RA_bacteria_t ~ log10_bacteria_cfu, data = cfu_bacteria_join)
summary(lm_bact)


label_text_bact <- sprintf(
  "Pearson r = %.2f | R² = %.2f | p = %.3g",
  sqrt(summary(lm_bact)$r.squared) * sign(coef(lm_bact)[2]),
  summary(lm_bact)$r.squared,
  coef(summary(lm_bact))["log10_bacteria_cfu", "Pr(>|t|)"]
)
label_text_bact

##graff
bacteria_plot <- ggplot(cfu_bacteria_join,
                              aes(x = log10_bacteria_cfu, y = RA_bacteria)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = treatment), size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "black") +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = treat.colors1,
    breaks = treat.order,
    labels = treat.labels,
    name   = "Treatment"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = expression(log[10]~"CFU g"^{-1}~"soil (aerobic cultivable bacteria)"),
    y = "Relative abundance (%) of putative\n cultivable aerobic bacteria "
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  annotate("text",
           x = Inf, y = Inf,
           hjust = 1.2, vjust = 1.3,
           label = label_text_bact,
           size = 4)

bacteria_plot
ggsave(bacteria_plot, file= "04_Figures/Figure_4_Bacteria.png", width= 1900,height= 1200, units= "px")


saveRDS(bacteria_plot, file = '03_Analysis_files/Figure_4_Bacteria.rds')

```
